name: M7.CompactStorage.storage_bounds
statement: ∀ (N H : ℕ) [NeZero N], M7.CompactStorage.coreBits N = 12*N+4 ∧ M7.CompactStorage.coreBits N ≤ 16*N ∧ M7.CompactStorage.tableBits N = Nat.totient N*(N+1) ∧ M7.CompactStorage.storedCoreBits N H ≤ 16*H*N ∧ M7.CompactStorage.storedWithTablesBits N H ≤ 16*H*N + 2*H*Nat.totient N*N
guidance: Unfold actual field-width sum. NeZero.pos gives N≥1, hence12N+4≤16N and N+1≤2N. ZMod.card_units_eq_totient gives exact optional table index count. Multiply bounds by H and combine algebraically. This is finite logical bit representation, not Lean object/runtime byte usage. Do not include full path/transcript in this core bound. Return tactic lines without leading by.
